title: The Shawshank Redemption
synopsis: You're convicted of a murder you didn't commit. Twenty years in Shawshank Prison. Hope is the most dangerous thing they let you carry.

nodes.text: Two life terms. The judge does not look at you. Your wife is dead. You did not kill her.

choices.consequence: “Plead innocent” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Pride.

nodes.text: The lights go out. Someone is sobbing. The fat man does not survive.

choices.consequence: “Don't sob” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Survive.
You commit to “Sob inside.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A man named Red runs the contraband. He sells you a rock hammer.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Read.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Bogs and his crew corner you. You learn what the showers cost.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Refuse.
You commit to “Survive the first attack.” The story records the instinct as “Endure” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A tar-roof detail. You overhear the head guard fretting about an inheritance tax.

choices.consequence: “Offer help” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: You get the men three beers each. You don't drink. You watch them remember what it is to be men.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Sip nothing.” The story records the instinct as “Detached” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Indulge—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You ask the warden for funding for the library. He says no. You write letters anyway. Once a week, for years.

choices.consequence: “Keep writing” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Patient.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Pressure.

nodes.text: A new young inmate named Tommy says he knew the man who really killed your wife.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Naive.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: The warden listens. He does not believe you. He does not, you realize, want to believe you.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
You commit to “Step back.” The story records the instinct as “Safe” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Tommy is killed by the guards in the yard. The official story is escape.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.
There is no taking “Vow” back. Plan shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Two months in solitary. You leave with a plan.

choices.consequence: “Make peace with the plan” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cold.
“Make peace with the cell” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Calm.

nodes.text: You play Mozart over the prison loudspeakers. For two minutes the yard goes silent.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Worth it.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Strategic.

nodes.text: Red tells you hope is dangerous. You tell him hope is everything.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mean it.

choices.text: Agree out loud and not inside
choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Strategy.

nodes.text: The library funding arrives, larger than asked. You build a small empire of books.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Use it.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Open.

nodes.text: The warden has, by now, made you his accountant. You launder money for him. You also, slowly, build a man named Stevens.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Patient.
You commit to “Build him fast.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Each night, after lockdown, you scrape. The hole is, by year nineteen, a tunnel.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Be patient.” The story records the instinct as “Years” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Years—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A thunderstorm. The night. You crawl through five hundred yards of pipe. You come out on the far side of the wall, on your knees, in the rain.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Free.
There is no taking “Stay on knees a moment” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You walk into a bank as Stevens and walk out with thirty-seven thousand dollars and a folder of evidence on the warden.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Right.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Petty.

nodes.text: A field in Buxton, Maine. Under a stone wall. A tin box. A note for Red.

choices.text: Leave it where you said you would
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Leave it where you said you would” back. Vow shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Take the tin and run” back. Survival shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Pacific. Mexico. A boat to fix. You wait.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Wait honestly” back. Patient shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Plan a small business” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Forward.

nodes.text: Years later, Red arrives on a bus. He walks the beach. He sees you. You raise a hand.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Friend.

choices.text: Wait for him to come to you
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You and Red fix the boat. You take tourists out. The Pacific is impossibly blue. You don't think about Shawshank often. When you do, you smile.
You write letters back to a literacy program at Shawshank. Books, in your name, fill that library for decades. Hope, you decide, is contagious.
You live small, on purpose. You and Red die old men by the sea. The tomato garden behind the cottage is, you tell tourists, the most important room in the house.
